title: Integrative Multi-Omics Analysis Suggests a Candidate Gut Microbiota-Butyrate-AP-1 Regulatory Axis in Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma.

title: Homologous Recombination Deficiency (HRD) Testing in Ovarian Cancer: Clinical Utility and Limitations.
snippet: Homologous recombination deficiency (HRD) is an important biomarker in ovarian cancer, but available assays interrogate different biological features and are not fully interchangeable. title: Integrative Characterization of a Telomere-Related Prognostic Signature Reveals Immune and Cellular Heterogeneity in Breast Cancer.
snippet: Breast cancer (BRCA) is a highly heterogeneous malignancy with diverse clinical outcomes, highlighting the need for reliable molecular biomarkers to improve prognostic stratification. title: An Exploratory Seven-Gene Expression Signature Obtained from Vasculogenic Mimicry-Related Genes Stratifies Prognosis in Cervical Cancer.
snippet: The prognostic value of vasculogenic mimicry (VM), vessel-like channels formed by tumour cells, rests on small cervical series. title: The Significance of Immune and Inflammatory Response Mediators in Endometriosis: New Perspectives for Diagnosis and Treatment.
snippet: Endometriosis is a chronic, estrogen-dependent inflammatory disease characterized by the presence of endometrial tissue outside the uterine cavity.
